observation: MEMORY.md rows cite their canonical home as a physical repository path. Moving the package-asset and documentation layout (docs/agents/ -> resources/ and docs/<category>/) invalidated four of those pointers at once, and the self-shape gate then refused the change because it reads any MEMORY.md edit as a durable-rule change that needs finding evidence.

evidence.summary: learningStatus() throws when MEMORY.md changed and no finding.*.json is in the diff, so a pointer-only repair fails the gate exactly like a new rule.
php tools/self-shape-dogfood.php failed with "MEMORY.md changed but no project finding was recorded" after the layout move updated four MEMORY.md evidence paths.

hypothesis: The gate cannot distinguish a rule edit from an evidence-pointer repair, because MEMORY.md stores the evidence reference as a path string rather than as an owner-resolved identifier.
validated_conclusion: A repository-layout move must treat every path-shaped evidence pointer as part of the move: update MEMORY.md rows and record the layout finding in the same change, or the durable rules quietly point at deleted files. Prefer citing evidence by a path an owner resolves (a class, a test name, a constant) over a directory that a layout slice can move.
